text:
Morgan H: Ok starting a short thread to align on the entitlement degradation schedule + KMS audit hook work. Goal: remove or downgrade stale admin entitlements over next 6 weeks, ensure KMS events are captured for any key admin ops.

Raj P: +1. can we define sampling windows and owner handoff? i want to avoid mass removal without owners.

Anna L: Suggest 3 waves: quick surface (7 days) -> owner reachout (14 days) -> degrade (21 days) -> final removal (42 days). owners assigned via OWNER tag in infra repo.

Julie K: Sounds good. For KMS, we need to capture AdminDecrypt/AdminEncrypt and Grant/Revoke events. Are we relying on cloud KMS audit logs or pulling from SIEM?

Morgan H: We'll wire both. Plan: KMS -> stackdriver/cloudlogging -> SIEM ingestion. But add a fallback lambda that query KMS IAM bindings weekly and emit findings.

sec-bot: Automated check: found 12 principals with "projects/*/serviceAccounts/*" bound to roles/cloudkms.admin in last 90d. See /alerts/27321.

Raj P: Can you paste the query you used? want to cross-check against our own inventory.

sec-bot: Query sample: ```gcloud asset search-all-iam-policies --scope=projects/my-prod --query='role:roles/cloudkms.admin' --format=json```

Anna L: For least-priv audits we should also run an activity-based filter to ignore service accounts that used KMS in last 30d. e.g. BigQuery of audit logs: ```SELECT principal, COUNT(*) as hits FROM `logs.kms` WHERE timestamp > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY principal```

Julie K: For remediation we prefer degrade -> monitor -> remove. degrade = roles/cloudkms.viewer + custom allow-encrypt for owned keys. That keeps apps running while removing broad admin.

Morgan H: Ops question: who will own the manual outreach? engineering managers or SRE oncall?

Raj P: Engineering managers own owner confirmation; SRE owns technical validation and rollback hooks. I'll create a rota doc.

Anna L: I'll draft the outreach template and the audit web UI filter (ownerless + last activity). Want to include a one-click degrade button that triggers IaC PR.

Julie K: Make sure the degrade PR includes KMS grant changes and an automated test that hits the target keys in staging.

ops-bot: Deploy notice: infra/degrade-playbook v1.2 deployed to staging at 2026-03-21T15:03:12Z.

Morgan H: OK next actions: Raj -> rota and rollback runbook (due 3 days). Anna -> outreach template + UI filter (5 days). Julie -> test matrix for degraded perms (5 days). I'll schedule a quick sync after that. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Anna L: one more thing — add a checkbox to the outreach: "I confirm I understand the business impact and will request re-elevation if needed." helps with evidence for audits.

Morgan H: added. Closing thread; will post follow-up PR links in this channel.
